question: Rio de Janeiro Governor Election Winner
resolution_criteria:
The Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026, with a runoff on October 25, 2026, if no candidate receives a majority of the valid votes in the first round.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder governors appointed by any means before the specified election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., www.tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes).

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I've excluded everything published after 2026-09-27, including later poll releases and later market pages.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on a consensus of credible reporting, or on official TSE results if reporting is ambiguous (tse.jus.br/eleicoes/resultados-eleicoes). On 2026-09-27 no official results could exist yet, because the first round is on 2026-10-04.
- 2026-09-24: The field of registered candidates, as polled by Datafolha: Eduardo Paes (PSD), Douglas Ruas (PL), Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos, running sub judice), William Siri (PSOL), André Marinho (Novo), Cyro Garcia (PSTU), Coronel Busnello (Missão), Juliete (UP) and Luan Monteiro (PCO). Dr. Luizinho, Eduardo Pazuello, Tarcísio Motta and Rafa Luz were not on the ballot list I found, so in practice their options are dead. [Gazeta do Povo/Datafolha](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/datafolha-governador-senador-rio-de-janeiro-setembro-2026-2/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing was settled as of 2026-09-27. The race had effectively narrowed to Paes and Ruas, with Paes leading every poll I found.
- 2026-09-11: TRE-RJ unanimously rejected Garotinho's registration. He is ineligible after an administrative-misconduct (improbidade) conviction that suspends his political rights, reportedly until 2033. He kept campaigning sub judice while appealing. Under Brazilian rules, votes for a candidate whose registration is finally denied are annulled and do not count as valid votes. That shrinks the base used to decide whether anyone has a first-round majority. [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/justica/noticia/2026-09/tre-rj-indefere-registro-de-garotinho-para-candidato-governador); [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/rio-de-janeiro/garotinho-reclama-de-demora-no-tre-rj-e-mantem-candidatura-ao-governo-do-rio/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-24: Datafolha poll (Sept 22-24, 1,204 interviews, margin of error ±3 points):
  - First round with Garotinho: Paes 43%, Ruas 30%, Garotinho 8%, each other candidate 2% or less, blank/null 6%, undecided 4%.
  - First round without Garotinho: Paes 46%, Ruas 31%.
  - Runoff: Paes 54%, Ruas 38%. [Gazeta do Povo](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/eleicoes/2026/pesquisa-eleitoral-2026/datafolha-governador-senador-rio-de-janeiro-setembro-2026-2/)
- 2026-09-23 (approx.): Quaest had Paes 36%, Ruas 23%. [Diário do Rio](https://diariodorio.com/politica/2026/09/29/quaest-paes-tem-34-e-douglas-ruas-25-diferenca-cai-para-9-pontos-no-rio.html)
- 2026-09-11: Datafolha had Paes 43% (41% on Aug 21), Ruas 25% (19% in August) and Garotinho 10%. Ruas has been climbing steadily. [CartaCapital/Gazeta](https://www.cartacapital.com.br/politica/datafolha-paes-lidera-disputa-ao-governo-do-rio-com-49-ruas-tem-28/)
- 2026-08-16 onward: The campaign launched. Flávio Bolsonaro backs Ruas and is tying Paes to Lula. Paes has PT and Lula support. On TV, Ruas runs on a "two Rios" message (the beachfront vs. Baixada and São Gonçalo), while Paes runs on his management experience. [Diário do Rio](https://diariodorio.com/eduardo-paes-douglas-ruas-e-garotinho-iniciam-campanha-ao-governo-do-rio-neste-domingo/); [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4343908/na-tv-ruas-contrapoe-rio-real-a-cartao-postal-paes-aposta-em-experiencia-no-rio)
- 2026-03-20: Paes resigned as Rio mayor to run for governor. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eduardo_Paes)

## 4. Base rates
- Paes is a well-known, three-term Rio mayor. However, he lost the 2006 and 2018 governor races; in 2018 he lost the runoff to Witzel, a political outsider who rose late in the campaign.
- Rio state voters have leaned right in recent statewide races. In 2022 Cláudio Castro (PL) won in the first round with about 58%, above what most polls had shown.
- In Brazil's 2018 and 2022 elections, polls tended to understate Bolsonaro-aligned candidates in the Southeast. That is a known risk for a lead of roughly 13 points that has been shrinking. These points are general background, not a quantified base rate. I did not find a systematic dataset of polling errors in Rio.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket "Rio de Janeiro Governor Election Winner" (opened 2026-06-09): an undated snapshot showed Paes 92.7%, Ruas 3.5%, with about $255K volume. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/rio-de-janeiro-governor-election-winner-20260608202949176); [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2487535)
- 2026-08-16: PredScope showed Paes at 97% (about $318K volume). [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/rio-de-janeiro-governor-election-winner-20260608202949176)
- Manifold: Paes was at about 78% at some earlier point. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Brierbr/brazil-2026-election-who-will-be-el-P82ES5QtLA)
- I could not confirm the Polymarket price exactly on 2026-09-27.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late September to early October: final Datafolha and Quaest polls and TV debates.
- Garotinho's appeals at TRE-RJ and the TSE. A final denial would annul his votes, roughly 8-10% in polls. That changes the first-round majority math and could let a candidate win outright or force a runoff.
- 2026-10-04: first round. 2026-10-25: runoff if needed. Recounts or vote re-tabulations tied to the Garotinho ruling could delay the final result.
